restaurantName: Caffe Concerto - Westfield Shopping Centre Stratford
address: Unit SU1054A, Westfield Shopping Centre, Stratford, London,E20 1GN
bio: Why not treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea in the heart of one of London's most buzzing areas at Caffe Concerto - Westfield Shopping Centre Stratford?  Ever since it opened in 1996, Caffe Concerto has taken London by storm with its perfect blend of European charm and passion for the fine art of patisserie.  Their Afternoon Tea is a classic interpretation of the British tradition consisting of delicate finger sandwiches with sumptuous fillings, freshly baked raisin and plain scones, alongside a delicious assortment of pastries and cakes. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco.  This Caffe Concerto site is situated just a short walk from Stratford station.
